title: Test forms supported in a fixed compact set have a countable subfamily approximating ω and dω uniformly
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set and let K ⊆ ℝ^P be compact. Then there is a countable set D ⊆ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n: C^∞ compactly supported n-forms on ℝ^P with tsupport in U) such that tsupport η ⊆ K for every η ∈ D, with the following property. For every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ K and every real ε > 0 there is η ∈ D such that, for every x ∈ ℝ^P, dist(ω(x), η(x)) < ε and dist(dω(x), dη(x)) < ε. Here d = exteriorDerivative, and dist(a, b) = ‖a − b‖ is the operator-norm distance on Covector (Euclid P) n, respectively Covector (Euclid P) (n+1).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → ∃ D : Set (TestFormOn U n), D.Countable ∧ (∀ η ∈ D, tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ η ∈ D, (∀ x, dist ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) < ε) ∧ ∀ x, dist (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) (exteriorDerivative (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) < ε
